ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area exceeding 90 percent, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized marks and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity pigmentation covers the entire visible fluke area. Sparse, high-contrast white geometric blobs (linear and punctate) are mapped primarily to the left lobe and lower central region of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation at the central axis with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged topography with variable amplitudes; the left lobe displays highly irregular, high-amplitude notches (peaks exceeding 10 pixels), while the right lobe displays a more uniform sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed concave curvature along the trailing boundary, converging symmetrically toward the central notch from tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast dark, textured cluster observed at the distal tip of the left lobe; small white circular pixel clusters are scattered across the mid-ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple horizontal and diagonal light-colored linear streaks (rake-like marks) concentrated on the mid-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and heavy scarring at the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple visible linear rake marks across the ventral plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical wear pattern characterized by extreme erosion on the left lobe tip compared to the relatively intact right lobe tip.
